Theorem
[Nonsingular solutions on $3$-manifolds admit geometric decompositions (Theorem 32.2)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0222, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0223, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0224 ↗ def:chow-iv-nonsingular-solution 1. ch32:32.2\group Nonsingular Solutions

If a closed $3$-manifold $\mathcal M$ admits a nonsingular solution of the normalized Ricci flow, then $\mathcal M$ is diffeomorphic to one of the following:

  1. a graph manifold;

  2. a spherical space form;

  3. a flat manifold;

  4. a hyperbolic manifold;

  5. a union, along incompressible $2$-tori, of finite-volume hyperbolic manifolds and graph manifolds.

In every case, $\mathcal M$ admits a geometric decomposition in the sense of Thurston.
